column_description: TEXT. Unique account reference. PK. Example: ACC7210284.
TEXT. Platform code reference. FK to platforms.
DATE. Original account creation timestamp. **NULL means account creation timestamp not provided.**. Example: 26-Dec-23.
BIGINT. Age of the account in days. Example: 393.
TEXT. Current state of the account. Possible values: Active, Deleted, Dormant, Suspended.
TEXT. Account form or type. Possible values: Bot, Business, Hybrid, Personal.
TEXT. Verification status of the account. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Suspicious, Unverified.
REAL. Profile score of the account. Example: 0.167.
